summary: Ethos Technologies filed an 8-K disclosing Q2 FY2026 results and a new $100 million share repurchase program authorized by its Board on August 2, 2026. Repurchases may occur on the open market, via pre-set plans, privately negotiated transactions, or other methods, with timing and amounts at management's discretion. No specific price, expiration, or obligation to acquire shares was stated. The program enhances shareholder returns alongside strong revenue growth of 113% year-over-year to $190 million. Watch for execution pace and balance-sheet impact; the flexible structure implies opportunistic buybacks.
